definition: Total invoiced/contracted value attributed to Guyana-registered supplier
interpretation_rule: Not equal to domestic value added.

definition: Imported goods/services embedded in local supplier contract
interpretation_rule: Subtract from gross value when estimating retained domestic value.

definition: Wages and salaries paid to Guyanese workers on covered activity
Profit attributable to verified Guyanese beneficial ownership
interpretation_rule: Requires economic ownership verification, not registration only.

definition: Domestic taxes and statutory contributions generated by local-content activity
interpretation_rule: Report separately from petroleum royalty/profit oil.

definition: Training expenditure tied to a defined occupational competency
Workers independently certified or signed off for defined roles

interpretation_rule: Track survival and export capability after initial contract.

definition: Local suppliers earning revenue from non-Guyana clients
interpretation_rule: Evidence of capability beyond protected domestic demand.

definition: Gross local procurement minus imported inputs and foreign-retained margins plus Guyanese wages/local profit/taxes according to defined accounting boundary
interpretation_rule: Core Edition 2 metric. Do not report until accounting boundary is disclosed.

definition: Inflation-adjusted household consumption/expenditure by region and income group
interpretation_rule: 2018/19 baseline cannot be presented as current 2026 outcome.

definition: Access to electricity, water, internet, health, education and transport by region
interpretation_rule: National averages can conceal regional divergence.

definition: Allocation, receipt, procurement, asset/service and maintenance chain for community programmes
interpretation_rule: Allocation alone is not delivered outcome.
